title: Fix the cost model
hints: Which part of the time gets smaller with more devices? Only the work does. The copies go one after another over the same wire.
Divide only `work` by `n`, then add the copy time `mb / speed` on its own.
explain: The work splits evenly over n devices, so it takes work / n. The copies do not split: they all travel over one wire, so they take mb / speed whatever n is. The starter divided the copy time by n as well, which makes extra devices look better than they are. With one device the data is already in place and nothing is copied.
